subject: Regarding your upcoming flight reservation
body: Dear [Recipient], we hope this email finds you well. We would like to inform you that there have been some updates to your upcoming flight reservation for your trip to Paris next month. Due to unforeseen circumstances, there has been a slight change in the departure time. Please review the attached document for more details and feel free to contact us if you have any questions or require further assistance. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and appreciate your understanding. Safe travels!
